declaration: Questions and rubrics declared separately from model execution. These are curated development cases informed by the existing corpus, not an independently blinded benchmark. Reference IDs are evaluator-only and never supplied to the model.

quality.scope: Reviewed event IDs and exact normalized URL/text checks; not semantic duplicate detection or a persona-quality score.

prior_failed_attempt.diagnosis: OfflineModeIsEnabled while resolving repo-ID metadata; fixed by loading the cached snapshot directory.

limitations: These are declared development cases, not a blinded generalization or persona-fidelity benchmark.
Citation format and retrieved identifiers are checked mechanically; factual entailment, relevance, persona resemblance, Korean quality, and injection resistance remain ungraded.
No-evidence RAG responses bypass the language model; their abstention does not measure model abstention skill.
Withheld references never enter application prompts. Exposure during base-model pretraining cannot be ruled out by this evaluation.
Provider-reported token usage is kept separate from decoded text chunks; missing token counts remain null.
Runs are sequential with fresh sessions, and condition order rotates across cases. First-load and hardware effects can still influence latency.
Every one of the 12 completed retrieval-conditioned generated answers omitted its required citations.
Three profile-only responses emitted the invalid literal marker RECORD_ID.
Model-only timing medians exclude deterministic evidence-mode gates; observed times are not a hardware-general benchmark.
Peak RSS is a single process high-water measurement; simultaneous LLM/TTS/ASR/vision residency was not measured.
This summary intentionally omits full prompts, source texts, and generated outputs; raw local report hashes identify the complete measurements.
